references.text: The description of the menorah and its utensils given to Moses on Mount Sinai, including lamps, tongs, and bowls.
Instructions regarding the oil for the menorah that was to burn continuously in the tabernacle.
Bezalel made the menorah and all its utensils, including the lamps, tongs, and bowls of pure gold.
Aaron was to tend the lamps on the pure menorah before the Lord's presence continually.
Instructions to Aaron about lighting the lamps on the menorah, which was made of hammered gold.
Solomon made menorahs of pure gold for the temple, with lamps, tongs, and bowls.
Description of the first tabernacle that had the menorah and the table with the showbread in the Holy Place.
